items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: My cousin named Brittany Henrietta, her husband was a bass horn player you know.

ctx.x: I want to ask a little bit about Vincent again. How did he play? Did he ever take the slide trombone later? Do you remember?

At that time when I was practicing with him he played a valve trombone. But he could play that thing. He used to take a solo on it you know. Was he a good musician? Could he read and all? Yeah he could read right now. I hadn't started reading then when he was reading. I used to wish that I was great like him. And finally I got out of the business. My cousin named Brittany Henrietta, her husband was a bass horn player you know. He the one that taught Eddie Jackson. And he told me where to go to to get some good…
Oh yes, I've heard of him. That's the end of it. That's right. That's right. Thank you.
